tools.name: download_meagain_app
tools.description: Open the MeAgain iOS app listing on the App Store in a new tab. Use when the user asks to download, install, or try the app.

tools.name: open_blog_post
tools.description: Navigate to a MeAgain blog post by slug, or to the blog index if slug is omitted. Slugs are discoverable via /llms.txt.

slug.description: Blog post slug (e.g. 'is-glp-1-the-same-as-ozempic'). Omit to open the blog index.
